sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:37 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, 2 x Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Equipment on, ready to start patrols, heading down Queen Street. Alpha Route in pursuit.
Arrived corner Queen & Wyndham Street intersection, streets still fairly empty, no issues.
Arrived corner Queen & Shortland Street intersection, same observation, no issues.
Arrived T4 square, carrying out a sweep. Moderate flow of civilians heading to work, no concerning issues.
Standing by Britomart McDonald's briefly to display presence given the earlier male vagrant dilemma this week.
Leaving station at Britomart McDonald's, heading back up Queen Street.
Arrived New World Metro, a vagrant outside gathering his belongings, seems to be relocating. No concerns regarding the male.
Quick pop in Vulcan Lane, carrying out a brief sweep.
Moderate traffic, no concerns. Continuing en route.
Received a call from Jo & Joes regarding what seemed to be a vagrant loitering in their lobby. Assistance requested to move him along.
Call back from Jo & Joes; the male removed himself from the vicinity, no further issues.
Inspected the area to ensure the male had left and wasn't static out front. All clear.
Arrived the Civic, no concerns in view, all clear.
Arrived Aotea Square, commencing floor checks.
Aotea Square all clear, no concerns.
Heading to Atrium Shopping center for a sweep.
Arrived Atrium shopping center, carrying out floor checks.
Atrium all clear, no sign of distress or concerns.
Heading back to Queen Street, heard a ruckus nearby; following the commotion it turned out to be a vagrant in front of Yoyoso in distress. Approached to check on the male's welfare.
Male was non-aggressive and received our concern well. Standing by to ensure no escalation.
Male vagrant has since calmed down. Moving on with usual patrols.
Heading back to HQ for briefing with Team 2.
Briefing with Team 2 concluded. Team 2 covering lower Queen Street, Team 1 upper Queen Street.
Commencing welfare checks on Upper Queen Street. Commencing Echo Route.
Arrived Aotea Square, standing by to show presence.
Standby concluded, no issues. Heading up to Mayoral.
Arrived Mayoral, scoping out the area, heading down to carry out check-ins and welfare checks.
Arrived Queens foodcourt, commencing welfare checks on stores in the vicinity.
Munster Inn & Nandos welfare check outside on main street, all clear. Resuming patrols.
Received a call from Remedy Cafe regarding a lady screaming up and down Wellesley Street verbally abusing people walking by. Female was disruptive; staff called for assistance.
Arrived Remedy Cafe; staff relayed the female had moved on shortly after contacting us. In-depth description provided; no female matching spotted. Will keep a lookout.
Received a call from Mecca regarding 5 individuals hanging around out front being disruptive and stopping potential customers from entering. Staff member regularly deals with these individuals.
Arrived Mecca, speaking to staff regarding the situation.

Spoke to the manager who gave a description of the group of 5, pointing out a female specifically reported to Police several times for slinging to fellow homeless on the corner of Queen & Victoria West. Group last seen heading down lower Queen Street. Photos to be sent; Auror report to be filed. Team 2 advised. Standby on Queen Street & Wellesley.
Team 2 close in the area; group have not come back. Resuming patrols.
Arrived Footlocker on the way up to Mayoral for a quick welfare check, no reports, all clear.
Lorne Street all clear. Welfare check at Sierra Cafe, no issues for them today.
Standing by to show presence, moderate traffic.
All clear. Heading back to office.
Team 2 dispatched to cover upper High Street. Charging ops phone at 11%.
Phone on 25%, heading out for another patrol down Queen Street.
Commencing welfare checks down lower Queen Street.
Arrived Imperial Lane, floor checks completed, standing by to show presence.
Leaving Imperial Lane, heading down to T4 Square for another sweep.
Arrived T4 square, active but no concerning issues. Standing by awaiting response calls.
Received a call from Ippondo regarding two vagrants in front of their store. Assistance requested to move them away from entry. Team 2 dispatched.
All clear at T4 square, youth in the area but behaviour satisfactory, no issues.
Heading back to HQ for 30 & handover with afternoon team.
Taking lunch break, preparing for changeover to the afternoon shift.
Handover completed, no further issues. Morning shift concluded.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Arrived and debriefing with B Team.
Heading on patrol; B Team takes upper Queen Street, we take lower.
Arrived corner Queen and Custom Street. All businesses from Farmers to Q Convenience all clear.
Britomart McDonald's, Commercial Bay, and stores in TK square all clear. Standby for presence.
Arrived corner Albert and Wyndham Street.
Welfare check on Cathedral area, all clear. Standby for presence.
Heading towards corner Victoria and Federal Street.
Arrived corner Victoria and Federal Street, commencing welfare checks.
Welfare checks businesses all clear. Standby for presence.
Notified Team B to assist with removing vagrants from CPNZ office on High Street while we remove a vagrant female from 175 Queen Street.
Received a call from Specsavers, heading to the location.

Female vagrant by the name Desiree reported by the manager entering the store with another female accomplice; together took 3 pairs of glasses, estimated value $459 each, total $1,377 NZD. Eyes on the female but she is being very aggressive. Requested assistance from Team 2 (outnumbered, group highly aggressive).

Spoke to the 2nd vagrant accomplice on Vulcan Lane; she acknowledged Desiree stole and that she was part of it, yelled/swore at us to go look for Desiree. Notified Team B to go back up and issue a trespass notice on behalf of Specsavers.
Followed the vagrants towards Britomart; now heading towards Gore Street after seeing them head towards the Viaduct. Standby for presence.
Heading back towards HQ to do handover with Team B.
Welfare checks on businesses from Starbucks to Yoso and NZ Muscle, all clear.
Arrived and doing a sweep of Aotea Square.
Area all clear. Standby for presence.
Received a call from Kiwiana regarding a theft. Heading to the location.
Received the report from the store worker; Desiree is the POI who stole. Retrieved photos of the POI; direction was up towards Civic. Didn't see her, going to look up towards Victoria Street.
No signs of her at corner Victoria and Federal Street. Heading towards Wellesley Street.
Arrived corner Wellesley and Elliot Street, heading through Elliot Street.
No signs of her, heading towards the Library via Lorne Street.
Library all clear, same for Lorne Street. Heading back to the office.
Charging ops phone at the office.
Heading to check on surrounding businesses.
Welfare check Localito, Queen Street McDonald's, 77 Convenience store, Mid City, Timezone and walkway through to Lorne Street. Heading towards High Street.
High Street and Vulcan Lane all clear. Heading to Chancery Square via O'Connell Street.
Freyberg Square, O'Connell Street and Chancery Square all clear. Standby for presence.
Arrived Fort Street, welfare check Pocket Park, Right Track, Wilson Carpark, and Jo&Joes. Heading towards Gore Street.
Welfare check Smiley Mart, Giapo, Chargrill, City Liquor, and Tribe, all clear. Standby for presence.
Received a call from Britomart McDonald's asking for assistance and then cancelling.
Received another call from them asking for assistance again. Heading to them now.
Just before arrival they said never mind, they left. Heading to office for break.
Standing by for handover and completing Auror reports.
Handover completed. Media on file: Desiree POI (photo on file).

sections.title: Day Shift — Team 2 (09:00 – 17:00)
items: Equipment: 1 x Camera, 1 x Radio, 2 x Vest. Standing by HQ debriefing with Team 1.
Debrief with morning shift complete. Team 2 patrolling lower Queen Street, gearing up.
Arrived High Street, welfare checks on stores.
Arrived Freyberg Square / Chancery Square, welfare checks along High Street all clear.
Freyberg Square / Chancery Square sweep complete, all clear.
Arrived Fort Street, welfare check KFC, Hoka, North Face, Walker & Hall, Right Track, Jo&Joes, Vape Haven, Evans Kebab, all clear.
Arrived Gore Street, welfare check Chargrill, Barfoot & Thompson, King Made Noodles, P&K Liquor, Smiley Mart, Auckland Harbour Suites, 77 Convenience, Sals Pizza, Siennas, all clear.
Arrived Commercial Bay, welfare check McDonald's Britomart all clear.
Commercial Bay sweep complete, all clear. Standby.
Arrived Reign n Pour welfare check, all clear.
Arrived lower Albert Street, welfare check Aotea Gifts, Woolworths, Remarkable Gifts, Albert Mart, all clear.
St Patrick's Square Cathedral sweep complete, all clear.
Arrived top of Victoria Street West, welfare check Amelia's Cafe, 101 Hair Salon, V Phix Mobiles, Mr Tacos, 77 Convenience, Coffee Club, Subway, The Fiddler, all clear. Standby.
Arrived bottom of Victoria Street West, welfare check Woolworths, Chemist Warehouse, ANZ, all clear. Patrolling down Queen Street with welfare checks.
Arrived Pocket Park, welfare checks on Queen Street stores all clear. Standby.
Arrived Gore Street, welfare checks on stores.
Arrived outside Right Track, welfare checks all clear.
Arrived Freyberg Square / Chancery Square, welfare checks along High Street all clear. Standby.
Arrived bottom of Victoria Street East, welfare checks all clear. Standby until break / route changeover.
Arrived HQ for combined 20 min interval break.
Team 2 patrolling upper Queen Street, commencing patrols.
Welfare check on upper Queen Street stores all clear. Standby outside McDonald's Queen Street.
Arrived top of Victoria Street West, welfare checks all clear. Standby.
Arrived bottom of Victoria Street West, welfare check all clear. Standby.
Arrived Lorne Street check in, commencing full sweep with welfare checks.
Arrived Auckland Library, welfare checks on Lorne Street / full sweep complete.
Arrived Elliot Street, welfare check all clear. Standby.
Arrived Darby Street, welfare check Celines, Mali Thai, Pizza Club, Domino's, Lumi Cafe, all clear.
Arrived outside Ippondo Queen Street, standby for nearby response calls.
Aotea Square sweep complete, all clear.
Arrived Lorne Street, standby outside patch for nearby response calls.
Response call from Team 1 about a vagrant outside CPNZ on High Street; assistance requested to remove the male individual from the building.
Arrived CPNZ, informed the male to move along; he complied. Standby.
Heading back to HQ for last 30 min break.

Check in 77 Convenience store, no issues.

Check in Queen Street Maccas, no issues.
Patrolling Aotea Square, commencing full sweep.
Aotea Square full sweep complete, all clear. Alpha route complete.
Check in corner Lorne Street / Wakefield, no issues.
Full sweep Kitchener Street / Chancery Square / Freyberg, all clear.
Full sweep Fort Street / Wilson Carpark, all clear.
Check in Gore Street, all clear. Beta route complete.
Check in Aotea Gifts, no issues.
Check in St Patrick's Square, all clear.
Check in 77 Convenience store, no issues.
Full sweep Victoria Street, all clear.
